name: Star Gun
storyline:
- It's been centuries that the Insectimorphs ruled in the 3rd System.
However, it was not enough for them...
Their power was primarily economic. Sale of ores, sand and other raw materials. But, this power was no longer sufficient.
Jealous of the other Systems, the Insectimorphs set up a plan that could make them Gods... but to the detriment of the other inhabitants of the universe
It principle : A huge galatic weapon able do destroy a sun
It slogan : More deadly, more power, more bucks
It name :
The STAR GUN

- But, some refuse to wait. The revolution will soon begin!
summary: A terror is about to arrive in the 3rd system. Its name is the STAR GUN. But all is not lost. A worker robot can still save us.
